name: Ningbo Jintian Copper (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Jintian Copper (Group) Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells copper-based products in China and internationally. The company offers bronze strip, brass strips, and copper plate and strips; copper valves, gas valves, cast steel valves, stainless steel valves, sanitary wares, water meters, and various pipe fittings; and gate valves, ball valves, stop valves, check valves, filter, temperature -sensing valves, reducing valves, vent valves, corrugated pipes, water meter, stopcock, water injection, and well choke.
